Contents.Subtitle: Host locally without package.json or build tool

Contents.Subtitle: Vite
Contents.Intro: Vite is a build tool for node.js web apps. Instead of raw dogging all local hosting during development and creating initial files from scratch, vite is one option to skip some of that manual and repetitive work.

Contents.Subtitle: Overall node.js development workflow
Contents.Intro: Regardless of the build tool, the commands in development workflow with all node.js applications is pretty much the same. The varying build tools usually create the package.json. Some create test configurations for unit tests.
